description:
Something went quiet on Mars.

Years later, we still can’t stop hearing it.

We’re Team Dormant, two friends who keep calling out to a machine that was only meant to last a season. We’re building a story you don’t read; you uncover. Dark screen. Static. Press play, and Mars answers.

As someone who sees in color, hears in sound, and builds worlds in code. Come find out what’s on the other end.

Hello, Mars?
